'''Barmellin''' is a farmer who lives near [[Tremonsien]].

==Activities==
During a delivery of brandy to [[Maglin Madwen]] at The [[The Nine Rings (inn)|Nine Rings]] in Tremonsien, he was frightened by the glow of the [[Choedan Kal]] during the [[cleansing of saidin|cleansing]] of ''[[saidin]]''. Because of this, he turns his horse [[Nisa]] around and rides very fast back to his farm.
